text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! ☆ Thank you so much for<n>the wishes!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears birthdays are particularly<n>special for you,
given your voice is<n>somehow at an even higher
pitch.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you notice things like that about<n>me? How
stupendously studious you<n>are! Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's the "marvelous" you say to<n>Nature, the one
you give to praise<n>someone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that's the "marvelous" you say<n>when you're
struck by sudden<n>surprise.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now this is a first! What kind of<n>meaning would you
say lies within<n>that "marvelous"?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It sprang up because we've grown<n>closer
together—a brand-new<n>marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays bring about all sorts of new<n>marvelous
things. What a marvelous<n>day!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems I still need more time to<n>understand... but
I'm very happy to<n>know we've become closer.
